description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing through only the log message, stripping away other metadata. It can be used to simplify on-screen logs for easy reading.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class implementing LogNode that passes only the message part of logs.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log messages to include only the message text and passes it along the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
